operatorProperties.code:
def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Report_Count.csv', skiprows=2)
    df = df.dropna(how='all')
    df = df[df['Year'].notna()]
    df = df[df['Year'] != '']
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['Year'].notna()]
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype(int)
    df['# of Reports'] = df['# of Reports'].str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    return df

def process(load_csn_data):
    df = load_csn_data.copy()
    df = df.sort_values('Year').reset_index(drop=True)
    df['YoY_Growth'] = df['# of Reports'].pct_change() * 100
    df['Absolute_Increase'] = df['# of Reports'].diff()
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Calculate year-over-year growth rate (%) and absolute increase in total reports from load_csn_data

operatorProperties.code:
def process(calculate_year_over_year_growth) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = calculate_year_over_year_growth[(calculate_year_over_year_growth['Year'] >= 2002) & (calculate_year_over_year_growth['Year'] <= 2024)]
    max_growth_idx = df['YoY_Growth'].idxmax()
    result = df.loc[[max_growth_idx], ['Year', 'YoY_Growth', '# of Reports']]
    return result

operators.customDisplayName: Filter data to years 2002-2024 inclusive, find the year with the greatest year-over-year growth rate in total reports
